resources.string: Show my game and session time on Discord

Optional. Requires the Android Discord app signed in and an Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal. No user token is needed. Enable activity sharing in Discord. Suspended time is excluded. Takes effect the next time you open a container.
Enter a valid public Discord Application ID (17–19 digits).
This build does not include Discord Social SDK 1.10+. Rich Presence is unavailable.
Discord SDK could not start. Check the SDK version and application logs.
Install the Android Discord app and sign in to use Rich Presence.
Waiting for a game window and its running process.
Discord has not accepted the update. Check that it is signed in; retrying automatically.
Game processes could not be verified. Presence cleared until the Windows helper responds.
LSFG is unavailable with the current Vortek swapchain. The game will run without frame generation.

Optional experimental PanVK for Mali-G52 MC2. Download the ZIP and import it using the driver install button above, then select it explicitly. Compatibility depends on Android and the kernel. This alpha is not Vulkan conformant and does not enable LSFG on Vortek.
This driver requires Android API %1$d or newer.
